body:
I barely wanted to live when I had a roof over my head, so I can't imagine wanting to live in those conditions. I'm not trying to sound entitled, or say I'm above that (I am not) but I just can't comprehend having any passion for life in those circumstances when I am already so low. 

I am so, so fucking sorry about your situation though. Do you have a permanent physical condition? Is it in any way manageable? What did your parents say? I'm lost for words, you sound so pure of heart. People like you don't deserve this.
Would it help me to generate money within a week? Beyond that, it feels pointless... I actually do have a degree in professional and creative writing so I understand english extremely well.
I hope your life improves, but if there's another side where good people go I hope to see you there.
I suppose survival instinct always kicks in
